newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian port of Paranagua reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Wind Star loading 14,000 tonnes bulk sugar, Panormitis loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags
Waiting to dock: six vessels to load using big bags, two to load bulk, one to load bagged sugar
Road: 165 trucks carrying sugar arrived on June 17
Loaded (June 17): 2,688 tonnes using big bags, 4,359 tonnes bulk sugar
Vessels: Turnstone, Daiana P, Symplea, Gemstar I, Tong Cheng, and Fulvia all loading bagged sugar, Nordkap loading 42,000 tonnes bulk sugar
Waiting to dock: two vessels to load bulk sugar, three vessels to load bagged sugar
Stocks: 32,804 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable
